'''Sligh''' was a [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] who, along with [[Grees]] and [[Emala]], formed the dubious group the [[Directors]]. For a while they made their profits by selling information they had collected to the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]], but later they found a new break on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the Squibs "helped" [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]] during their [[Mission to Tatooine (Killik Twilight)|skirmishes]] on Tatooine while trying to obtain the [[Moss painting/Legends|moss painting]] ''[[Killik Twilight]]''. They realized that selling information to the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] would be more profitable, and later started [[Second Mistake Enterprises]].

After surviving the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] he became a war profiteer along with Grees and Emala during the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]]-[[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Swarm War]]. After being sabotaged by the Solos, they took out a bounty on each of the family's heads.
